goal: Serve witness-free block requests to peers much faster and with lower memory overhead
Avoids download bottlenecks when serving legacy peers or nodes running witness-skipping IBD
reviewability: Conflicts with master, but reviewing logic now is worthwhile because the rebase is mechanical
agreement: Strong support with extensive verification across multiple rebases without objections (fametrano)
Verified byte-for-byte output equivalence and speedups on mainnet and regtest blocks (fametrano)

Eliminates heavy heap allocations and transaction rehashing overhead when serving peers
Enables efficient peer block serving for pruned assumevalid initial block download
